thread:
pat_ops: Quick FYI 00-unit mixed GPU pallet from AeroChip arrived at ORD-hub. 9 units failing POST. Vendor proposes 6 air-replacements to DFW-depot-3 and 3 sea-return. AWB pending. Need decision on who covers brokerage and expedite split. @romy_procurement @sam_logistics

romy_procurement: Ask for serials, DOA photos, and an itemized air quote (carrier, fuel surcharge, handling, brokerage). Also clarify vendor will include declared value. Which ledger do we charge 1 infra-capex?

sam_logistics: If air, route to DFW-depot-3 for same-day swap. Depot requires manifest_v2 CSV + PDF RMA labels and a commercial invoice with declarant. No crossdock. ETA ~30-36h after AWB.

anya_platform: Capacity note: NA Dedicated pool = 220 H100s. Losing 9 = ~4.1% capacity; recommend spinning up 3 hot-spare instances in NA for 48h if we expedite. Est cost ~$1.1k/day. Approve?

pat_ops: Vendor note (pasted): failures = "no POST / PSU or NVLink fault" for 9 units. Serials (redacted): H100-AC-801..H100-AC-809. Air quote = $34,200 + brokerage (vendor claims). AeroChip asks Redwood to pre-pay brokerage and accept full expedite split 55% citing carrier surge. They prefer consolidated depot-to-depot AWB.

romy_procurement: 55% is unreasonable. Counter 25% expedite share if vendor covers brokerage and provides carrier receipts showing surge breakout. We will not pre-pay brokerage without invoice and customs paperwork. Require signed DOA forms and timestamped photos prior to payment.

sam_logistics: Agreed. Depot manifest example (manifest_v2):

AWB,Carrier,ShipFrom,ShipTo,ItemCount,Serials,HSCode,DeclaredValue,Insurance,RMA_type
TBD,TBD,AeroChip,DFW-depot-3,6,"H100-AC-801;H100-AC-802;H100-AC-803;H100-AC-804;H100-AC-805;H100-AC-806",84733000,510000,yes,swap

Depot will reject shipments without correct manifest_v2 + commercial invoice.

anya_platform: If vendor accepts our counter (25% + vendor covers brokerage and shows receipts), I'll reserve 3 hot-spares and reroute critical jobs to EU pool during swap window. If vendor refuses, we choose sea-return and schedule repair lane (~12 business days).

pat_ops: Uploaded preliminary DOA photos and run logs: https://files.redwood.internal/rma/4155551234/ (placeholder). Vendor replied: "we will only accept 40% if Redwood signs a PO addendum and issues AWB within 3h." They offered to split brokerage 50/50 if we pre-pay.

romy_procurement: Counter-offer: 30% expedite if AeroChip covers brokerage or provides carrier invoices proving brokerage is legitimate and that carrier surcharge is >30%. No PO addendum until legal approves terms. Tagging legal_team for addendum review.

legal_team: Will review PO addendum; we cannot sign clauses that shift customs liability without finance approval. Tag @romy_procurement/legal-review.

sam_logistics: Action items:
1) pat_ops - provide full serial manifest + timestamped DOA photos + vendor commercial invoice by 16:00 CDT.
2) romy_procurement - send PO counter (30% with carrier receipts or vendor covers brokerage) and request breakdown.
3) sam_logistics - provision DFW-depot-3 conditional slot and pre-alert template.
4) anya_platform - reserve 3 hot-spares in NA pool for 48h if AWB issued.
SLA target: 72h E2E from AWB to swap complete.

ops_bot: Reminder set 1 follow-up with AeroChip in 4h for AWB and brokerage receipts.

pat_ops: If AeroChip refuses to produce receipts, escalate to finance. We should not pre-pay unknown brokerage amounts.

romy_procurement: Agreed. We'll avoid paying >35% expedite without invoices. If vendor remains firm on 55% and pre-pay, decline air and opt for sea-return. :thinking:
